name: Fletcher
source: Handsome, single, and (most importantly) rich, Fletcher is just the sort of man Robin likes to cozy up to. However, she quickly realizes that his sweet talk might be hiding a not-so-sweet personality. Apparently aquainted with detective Wren, Robin has to wonder if he's hiding anything else...
